name: line_chart
description: A time-series line chart that plots metric values over time. Supports multiple overlaid lines.

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The primary metric to plot as the base line

config.name: history_count
config.label: History count
config.description: The number of data points to keep visible on the chart. Higher values show more history

config.name: min
config.label: Min Value
config.description: The minimum value on the Y-axis. If not set, it is automatically calculated from the data

config.name: max
config.label: Max Value
config.description: The maximum value on the Y-axis. If not set, it is automatically calculated from the data

config.name: line_scale
config.label: Scale
config.description: The scale function for the Y-axis. Linear is the default; logarithmic compresses large ranges; quadratic and cubic emphasize higher values

config.name: yaxis_label_color
config.label: Label Color
config.description: The text color of the Y-axis labels

config.name: yaxis_label_font_size
config.label: Font Size
config.description: The font size of the Y-axis labels in pixels

config.name: yaxis_label_font
config.label: Label Font
config.description: The font family used for Y-axis labels

config.name: yaxis_label_space
config.label: Label Space
config.description: The amount of horizontal space reserved for the Y-axis labels in pixels

config.name: hide_yaxis
config.label: Hide
config.description: Hides the Y-axis and its labels for a cleaner look

config.name: line_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The stroke color of the line

config.name: fill_line
config.label: Fill Line
config.description: Enables a filled area beneath the line

config.name: line_fill_color
config.label: Fill Color
config.description: The color of the filled area beneath the line when Fill Line is enabled

config.name: line_width
config.label: Line Width
config.description: The thickness of the line stroke in pixels

config.name: line_curve
config.label: Line Curve
config.description: The interpolation style between data points. Linear connects with straight lines, monotone creates smooth curves that preserve monotonicity, natural creates smooth natural-looking curves

config.name: additional_lines
config.label: Add Lines
config.description: Add extra metric lines to overlay on the same chart for comparison

config.name: metric
config.label: Metric
config.description: The metric to plot for this additional line

config.name: line_color
config.label: Color
config.description: The stroke color of this additional line

config.name: line_fill_color
config.label: Fill Color
config.description: The fill color beneath this additional line when Fill Line is enabled
